\newcommand{\libraryfindings}{CapyMOA is faster in 8 of 16 pairs. Its largest speedup is 3.8\ensuremath{\times} for ARF on SEA shift. Its largest accuracy gain is +1.83 pp (ARF, Gas sensor drift), and its largest loss is -33.99 pp (Logistic, EEG eye state).}

\newcommand{\librarymemory}{Sampled process peak RSS was 186--207 MiB across River's classification runs and 277--377 MiB for CapyMOA.}
